traits.name: fierce
traits.reason: Lines are clipped when Lagalong leaves, but there is no sharp response to being crossed; she builds roads, though that is not framed as mending damage.

traits.name: loyal
traits.reason: She keeps directing Lagalong east six, says a bridge waits, urges him to hurry, and builds roads toward him; joy at his arrival is not yet shown.

traits.name: jealous
traits.reason: Clipped lines on Lagalong leaving, 'Jealous light!', 'He left again. Building.' and she builds harder afterward.
